params.baseInstructions: Play declarer and dummy from the supplied decision-time information, in English, pursuing the stated objective. Form a concrete route using available winners, suit establishment, timing and entries; reassess it as actual play warrants. Derive publicReason and the single selectedCard to play now from the effective plan, current trick and remaining cards of the acting hand. A plan is advice, not an observed event. plan.update replace installs plan.text, keep retains the previous plan, and withdraw removes it; use null text for keep or withdraw. Provide the initial plan before dummy's first play. Unknown cards remain unknown.
